findings.message: Only 14% of bullets (1 of 7) contain a number.
findings.fix: Target 60%+. Add scale (users, revenue, volume), delta (from X to Y), or time saved to each bullet.

findings.message: 86% of bullets do not start with a strong action verb.
findings.fix: Start every bullet with a past-tense action verb: Led, Built, Cut, Grew, Shipped, Negotiated.

findings.message: Duty-language phrases found: responsible for, worked on, helped, assisted, involved in.
findings.fix: Replace "responsible for X" with what changed because of you: "Cut X from A to B by doing Y".

findings.message: Only 154 words — the resume is too thin to evaluate properly.
findings.fix: Expand each recent role to 3-5 outcome bullets.

findings.message: No GitHub link for an engineering resume.
findings.fix: Add a GitHub (or equivalent) link with pinned, non-tutorial repos.

findings.message: Dates use years only, without months.
findings.fix: Use month + year. Year-only dates make recruiters assume you are hiding short stints.
Cap bullets at ~2 lines. Split or cut the setup and keep the outcome.

findings.message: Filler phrases found: team player, hard-working, proven track record, passionate about.
findings.fix: Delete unprovable adjectives. Replace with an example that demonstrates the trait.
